x6a.scope: LIBERO-10 only;500 episodes per model; accepted episodes copied verbatim. Only250 missing uniform-M2 episodes are new and may use a different measured GPU. Device/backend effects are a confound not captured by episode CIs. Paired task/episode bootstrap,2000 draws, pointwise95% intervals conditional on seed7. No selection based on observed winners.

x6b.scope: FP full10030 instances once; equal fixed500 camera+500 robot-initial-state instances per model, FP subset reused from full run. No extra same-GPU controls. Hardware/backend differences, where present, are not removed by paired CIs.
